content:
maria: :rotating_light: seeing a sudden spike of 500s on /v1/generate around 22:12 UTC. latency also up. Dashboard: https://dash.prod.redwood/apps/gateway?panel=route-breakdown

sam: which routing policy was in the last deploy? header-weights-v2?

maria: yes, header-weights-v2. It started matching on `x-routing-kind` and diverted ~60% traffic to pool-b (low-capacity).

devon: I pushed header-weights-v2 yesterday to support staged traffic. I tested on canary but looks like the matching rule was too broad.

olivia: do not redeploy code. We have a runtime toggle for policies in the Console (Routing -> Policies). Flip header-weights-v2 to disable to stop matching immediately.

sam: can someone flip it? Prefer API so we have a clean audit trail. Admin API endpoint is: 

```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://admin.redwood/api/v1/toggles/header-weights-v2/disable
```

raj: I'm on bastion getting admin keys. tagging @infra-bot for approval.

infra-bot: :lock: action_required - admin approval required to change toggle `header-weights-v2`. Request posted to ops-approvals. Audit will be recorded.

raj: approved in ops-approvals. running the disable now.

deploy-bot: executed toggle change by raj at 2026-03-18T22:18:05Z

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"ok","change_id":"chg_20260318_01","toggle":"header-weights-v2","active":false}
```

maria: traffic shifted back to the high-capacity pool, 200s restored and latency normalized. Thanks. We did see a brief KV cache thrash for the prefix cache (some latent rate spikes).

devon: noted — follow-up: replace the abrupt weight swap with a gradual ramp and add a safety threshold (if low-capacity usage > 20% then abort). Filing infra issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/987

olivia: please update the runbook (docs/runbooks/routing-playbooks.md) with the exact Console path and API example we used here. Also file a console UX bug: the toggle is nested under two menus which blocked quick access.

sam: will open a tiny postmortem and runbook PR. Also adding a telemetry alert: when route weight delta >20% in 5m then page oncall.

maria: adding note — we should also add an automatic fallback to a compatible model variant (same region) instead of switching to low-capacity pool. Opening a design ticket.

raj: marking incident resolved. closing thread after PRs created. :thumbsup:
